title: Split items evenly
prompt: Write split_evenly(n, k) returning a list of k non-negative integers summing to n, as even as possible, larger parts first. k >= 1.
teacher_lesson: Use integer arithmetic (divmod or //) for counts; a float quotient is never an integer count and loses the remainder.

mock.label: MOCK — scripted student, not a model
mock.first_attempt:
def split_evenly(n, k):
    return [n / k] * k
mock.student_lesson: Use integer arithmetic (divmod or //) for counts; a float quotient is never an integer count and loses the remainder.
